decision: The owner retired the Phase 2 expert-review requirement. The requirement is withdrawn, not satisfied.
denominatorRule: The criterion stays among the four Phase 2 formal exit criteria and is counted as not complete. Retirement withdraws a requirement; it cannot raise the completion percentage. Phase 2 formal exit remains 2/4.
consequences: No expert review of the per-cell geometry was performed, and none is planned under this criterion.
The per-cell patches remain not countable and not production eligible. Expert review was the route by which they could have become countable, so retiring it closes that route.
Site copy must state the limitation without implying a review is pending.
